context_requirements: Expression of the direct target(s) of the specific agent (e.g., ESR1 for endocrine agents, CYP11A1/CYP11B1 for steroidogenesis inhibitors)
Intact downstream growth/survival signaling that the agent antagonizes
For antiestrogens: ER-positive lineage (e.g., MCF7); ER-negative lines (PC3, A549, A375) are expected to be largely unresponsive
For CYP11A1/CYP11B1 inhibitors: steroidogenic capacity or dependence on steroid hormone synthesis
falsifiers: No change in any of the listed proximal or late genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
A clear, strong transcriptional response in ER-negative lines (PC3, A549, A375) comparable to MCF7, which would argue against an ER-dependent mechanism
Absence of any antiproliferative signature (e.g., no decrease in CCNA2, CCNB1, CDK1, or other cell-cycle genes) at 24 h in responsive lines
A response that is equally strong at 6 h and 24 h with no late-emerging secondary program, contradicting the expected slow kinetics
